focus: UX for the operator and the AI user who executes /deep:research:auto: verify the six orchestrator-reported defects (dispatchId generation token, executor.type vs kind, quota-error iteration slot + archive-on-executor-change, 12-vs-24 tool-call budget, undefined focus in the state summary, missing persona block) and rank by operator cost
answeredQuestions: UX: which steps of `deep-research-auto.yaml`, `deep-research-presentation.txt` or the `cli-*/SKILL.md` dispatch rules are unclear, contradictory or impossible to execute for the operator or an AI user?

graphEvents.label: Which deep:research:auto steps are unclear, contradictory or impossible for operator and AI user
dispatchId uses {generation} in cursor/devin/pi but post_dispatch_validate requires {config.lineage.generation}
Executor gates read config.executor.type while schema key is kind
Leaf budget hard-coded at 12 tool calls while config allows 24
State summary focus renders undefined; no producer for last_focus or last_3_summaries
Quota error burns an iteration slot and executor swap requires restart that archives research
Persona injection required by hub, absent from pack, rejected by cli-pi executor policy

label: dispatchId is built from the bare token {generation} in the cursor, devin and pi branches (deep-research-auto.yaml:1327, :1428, :1530) while post_dispatch_validate (:1816) and the claude-code/opencode/codex branches (:1253, :1639, :1737) require {config.lineage.generation}; the dispatch receipt, fencing label and validator therefore disagree on the identity of the same dispatch, so the run either labels it 'research-iN-g{generation}' with no matching receipt or fails its own record with schema_mismatch. git log -S places the token at 330427cf30 (2026-09-17), so the defect is inherited from pre-v4.0.0.0 rather than introduced by v4.0.0.15.
confidence: high on the drift, medium on which failure mode fires

label: Every executor gate in deep-research-auto.yaml reads config.executor.type (skip_when :1198, branch_on :1204, executorKind :1248, :1585) while the config and the runtime schema use kind, so the skip_when comparison against 'native' and the branch selector are fed an undefined field; the hand-written prose fallback at :1796 ('when this run is ITSELF a fan-out CLI lineage ... do not run this dispatch script') is the evidence that the typed gate does not fire. Field-name defect also pre-dates v4 (7a2dd5401a, 2026-10-03).
confidence: high that field names disagree, medium that no normalisation maps kind onto type

label: The leaf tool-call budget is a static template line ('Max 12 tool calls total', prompt-pack-iteration.md.tmpl:36) duplicated in deep-research/SKILL.md:104 and deep-review loop-protocol.md:708, while config.maxToolCallsPerIteration is 24 and no code path reads that field; a compliant leaf under-researches by half and a config-compliant leaf violates the prompt it was handed.

The state summary's focus line has no producer: last_focus and last_3_summaries exist only as prose instructions at deep-research-auto.yaml:619 and :632 ('Extract focus from latest iteration record, else none yet' / "run N: focus (ratio)"), and append-mode-event.cjs never touches focus; this iteration's own injected prompt renders 'Last focus: undefined' and 'run 5: undefined (0.72); run 6: undefined (0.63); run 7: undefined (0.81)', so the operator's only live 'what is this run doing' signal has been dead for eight consecutive iterations and the leaf's anti-repetition signal carries a score with no direction.
confidence: high (observed in the prompt this iteration was dispatched with)

label: An executor quota error is recorded as a canonical iteration row with status error (deep-research-auto.yaml:2040), the same type=maxIterations counts, so a devin resource_exhausted is indistinguishable from a real attempt to the cap; and the only live lineage mode that resets executor state is restart (:323) which archives to archive_root (:330) while fork and completed-continue are explicitly not runtime-supported (:332), so changing executor.kind to dodge the quota error costs the run its findings-registry, strategy and containment ledger.
confidence: high on both mechanisms, medium that no quota-specific non-counting branch exists in the reducer

label: Persona injection is a triple contradiction: cli-external-orchestration/SKILL.md:189 and :217 require the resolved agent persona on every external-CLI dispatch, the prompt-pack template and the 2,300-line dispatch YAML contain zero persona references, and the executor schema explicitly rejects agentPersona for the cli-pi kind this run uses (executor-config.vitest.ts:420); every source is locally satisfiable so nothing fails and a dispatched CLI silently runs without a persona - the 'impossible to execute' class the topic asked for.
confidence: high on the contradiction, medium that cli-pi injects persona out-of-band on the command line

label: The operator-cost ranking differs from the order the six claims were asked in: the two identity defects (001, 002) outrank the budget and focus defects because they are silent, the focus defect outranks the archive-on-swap cost because it has already degraded eight consecutive iterations, and persona is last because it lowers quality without failing anything.

All six defects pre-date the v4 release line: git log -S bottoms out at 330427cf30 (2026-09-17) for g{generation} and Max 12 tool calls, and 7a2dd5401a (2026-10-03) for config.executor.type. The v4 line rewrote the dispatch around them and added a prose fallback instead of fixing the field binding, so 'release that introduced it' answers none for this cluster.

label: The canonical state-log projection is not a superset of the required iteration record: the record this iteration handed to append-mode-event.cjs carried 14 fields (runId, sessionId, lineageId, mode, target_agent, focus, answeredQuestions, graphEvents, ...) and the projected row carries 7 (type, iteration, run, status, newInfoRatio, ruledOut, timestamp). focus, answeredQuestions, generation and sessionId are all dropped. This is the proven producer-side root cause of f-iter008-004 (the summariser is handed a row with no focus, hence "run N: undefined (ratio)") and it also means a dashboard or registry rebuild driven from the state log alone - the exact recovery path the DECLARED contract names - loses per-generation fencing identity and every answered-question set.
confidence: high (observed: the row was read back from deep-research-state.jsonl after the gateway committed it)

label: Severity-ordered correction after post-gateway verification: f-iter008-007 is the highest-value finding of this iteration, not f-iter008-001. The identity defects 001/002 mislabel a dispatch; 007 silently discards the state that every downstream consumer reads, and it was only visible by reading the state log back after the gateway wrote it - which is why seven prior iterations reported the symptom and never the cause.
